behavior_en: The complete 60 B proxy body does not save, retain, release, branch on or otherwise explicitly use incoming unarchiver x3. Residual x3 at a call is not proof that the callee uses it.

behavior_en: The returned object is retained by objc_retainAutoreleasedReturnValue, saved as x19, then receives longValue directly; there is no caller-side nil/type/error branch in this sequence.
